question: How long do grid companies have, counted from the decision to start, to submit a joint recommendation on redrawing price areas?

verdict.gold_reason: Article 32(4)(b)(iii) of Regulation 2015/1222 says the participating TSOs submit a joint proposal to maintain or amend the bidding zone configuration within 15 months of the decision to launch a review. This matches the reference answer.

other_articles.why: Article 14(6) also sets a TSO joint-proposal deadline on bidding zone configuration, but it is 12 months after approval of the methodology and assumptions, not after the decision to launch the review. It does not answer the question as worded.

verdict.ambiguity_reason: Regulation 2019/943 Article 14(6) sets a different deadline (12 months) for a similar proposal. The question's anchor, 'counted from the decision to start', points to Article 32 of the CACM Regulation.
verdict.suggested_fix: Optionally name the Regulation (CACM) or say 'decision to launch a bidding zone review' to rule out the 2019/943 Article 14(6) timeline.
